faq.title: Setting up your line
faq.subtitle: Helpful answers while you configure it.

lineDetails.question: Which line details are required?
lineDetails.answer: Only the line name is required. Location is optional, but adding it helps visitors find the correct counter, floor, room, or service point.

otherType.question: What if my line type is not listed?
otherType.answer: Select Other and enter your own line type, such as document collection, admissions, repairs, interviews, or any service that suits your workflow.

advanced.question: Do I need to complete Advanced settings?
advanced.answer: No. Average service time and daily capacity are optional and can be left blank. Notification and intake controls already have sensible defaults and can be changed later.

questions.question: What should I ask visitors?
questions.answer: The Information to collect section is optional. Ask only for information your team needs before service, such as a name, phone number, appointment ID, party size, department, or service type.

answerTypes.question: Which answer type should I choose?
answerTypes.answer: Use short text for names or IDs, phone or email for contact details, number for values such as party size, and multiple choice when visitors should select from fixed options.

multipleChoice.question: When should I use multiple choice?
multipleChoice.answer: Use multiple choice for predictable answers such as department, service type, appointment category, or preferred counter. Add only the options your team can actually serve.

required.question: Should every answer be required?
required.answer: No. Make a question required only when your team cannot provide the service without that information. Fewer required fields make joining faster.

editQuestions.question: Can I change these questions later?
editQuestions.answer: Yes. You can review, add, remove, or update joiner questions before sharing the line, and the setup can support later edits when line management is connected.

after.question: What happens after I continue?
after.answer: If you are not signed in, your draft is saved while you authenticate. After sign-in, create the line and LineME will generate its unique line code.
